frigate_camera_help: The list comes from the selected instance. If it stays empty, the instance is not running or does not know any cameras yet.
frigate_dialogPollingInterval_help: Applies while the enlarged view is open. A lower value gives a smoother picture and only costs something while someone is watching.
frigate_fps_help: Frigate encodes the stream for every viewer - a low value saves CPU
frigate_live_needs_web: This widget streams through the camera proxy of the web adapter. Without a web instance use the snapshot widget instead.
frigate_name_help: Overrides the camera name shown on the tile. Leave empty to use the camera name itself.
frigate_pollingInterval_help: How often the tile requests a new picture
frigate_stream_needs_web: Stream not reachable. Enter the web instance in the settings.
frigate_webUrl_help: Leave empty: the adapter works the address out from the web instance and its host. Only fill this in when that cannot be right, e.g. behind a reverse proxy or an external domain - then something like http://192.168.1.5:8082
frigate_web_disabled: Camera proxy is switched off. Pick a web instance under "Camera proxy" in the frigate instance settings.
frigate_web_error: The address of the web instance could not be worked out. See the adapter log for details.
frigate_web_noAddress: The host of the web instance has no reachable address. Please enter the web instance manually.
frigate_web_noInstance: No running web instance. The live view needs the web adapter - otherwise use the snapshot widget.
